in_sanskrit.name: तेजश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root 'tejas' which means radiance, brightness, glory, splendor. This name signifies one who has the quality of radiance and brightness, one who is glorious and splendid.

in_hindi.name: तेजश
in_hindi.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'tejas' meaning radiance, brightness, glory, splendor. In Hindi, the name is written as 'तेजश' (Tejash) which is a combination of 'तेज़' (Tejaz) and 'श' (Sh).

in_tamil.name: தெஜாஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil form of the name 'Tejash' is 'தெஜாஷ்' (Tejash). The meaning of the name is 'ஜோதிழல்' (Jothizhal) which means 'one who possesses light, one who is bright'.

in_telugu.name: తేజశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu form of the name 'Tejash' is 'థేజశ్' (Tejash). The meaning of the name is 'జోటిపోహోయేళ్ళు' (Jotipowhoyelu) which means 'one who possesses light, one who is bright'.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Tejash" is rooted in Hindu culture, which reveres the Sun God as Tejas. This name signifies the warmth, brilliance, and endless energy of the sun. It symbolizes the carrier of courage, strength, and leadership, as the sun rises with determination every morning and illuminates the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the Sun is considered the source of all life and an embodiment of cosmic energy. Tejash is a reflection of this divine power within a person. Spiritually, this name comes with a deep meaning—a reminder to radiate positivity, enlightenment, and inner strength, thus making the world a better place, just like the Sun does every day.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Tejash continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Tejash: Radiating with the divine inner light and warmth of knowledge and wisdom. Symbolizing the illuminated soul, shining brightly in spiritual growth.
